subject: Deku Nut Upgrade 2
text: Showcasing the Mask of Truth at the Forest Stage in the Lost Woods upgrades your carrying capacity to 40 Deku Nuts, but this upgrade cannot be obtained after pulling out the Master Sword for the first time.

evidence.quote:
This upgrade allows you to carry 40 Deku Nuts!...From the Kokiri Forest 
 entrance, head right, left, right, left, then left to get to a grassy area. 
 Find the Forest Stage, then showcase the Mask of Truth to the group...NOTE: You can NOT get this upgrade after pulling out the Master Sword for the
first time. It's a strange glitch that Nintendo hasn't bothered to fix for
some reason. Make sure you get the upgrade before becoming Adult Link.

subject: Big Quiver
text: Hitting all the Rupees at the Shooting Gallery in Kakariko Village as Adult Link rewards the Big Quiver upgrade, which allows holding 40 Arrows.

evidence.quote:
This is upgrade is a Big Quiver, allowing you to hold 40 Arrows
 for your Bow...Head to Kakariko Village as Adult Link, and enter the Shooting
 Gallery...Hit all the Rupees to get this upgrade.

subject: Biggest Quiver
text: Acquiring 1500 points in the Horseback Archery Game at Gerudo's Fortress rewards the Biggest Quiver upgrade, allowing Link to hold 50 Arrows.

evidence.quote:
This upgrade is the Biggest Quiver, allowing you to hold 50 Arrows
 for your Bow...Acquire 1500 points (very hard) in the Horseback Archery Game at
 Gerudo's Fortress.

subject: Deku Sticks
text: You can carry 10 Deku Sticks when first collected; they can be bought or taken from certain Deku Babas and cannot be used by Adult Link.

evidence.quote:
You can only carry 10 Deku Sticks at the time you collect them, but there are some
 upgrades that'll let you carry more. Adult Link can't use these...They can either be bought or taken from certain Deku Babas.

subject: Deku Nuts
text: Deku Nuts can either be bought or taken from certain Deku Babas.

evidence.quote: Gotten: They can either be bought or taken from certain Deku Babas.

subject: Bomb Bag
text: The ability to carry bombs is found in Dodongo's Cavern, the second dungeon as Young Link.

evidence.quote:
Gotten: The ability to carry bombs hides in Dodongo's Cavern, the second 
 dungeon as Young Link.

subject: Fire Arrows
text: Fire Arrows are obtained in Lake Hylia by shooting the sun right as morning arrives after clearing the Water Temple.

evidence.quote:
Gotten: After clearing the Water Temple, shoot the sun right as morning arrives
 to get these. You have to be in Lake Hylia for this to happen.

subject: Ice Arrows
text: Ice Arrows are the prize for clearing the Gerudo Training Grounds.

evidence.quote: Gotten: Your prize for clearing the difficult Gerudo Training Grounds.

subject: Light Arrows
text: After clearing all temples and obtaining all medallions, returning to the Temple of Time will result in Zelda giving Link the Light Arrows.

evidence.quote:
Gotten: After clearing all the temples and getting all the medallions, return
 to the Temple of Time and Zelda will give these to you.

subject: Fairy Slingshot
text: The Fairy Slingshot is obtained in the Deku Tree dungeon and cannot be used by Adult Link.

evidence.quote: Adult Link can't use this...Gotten: In the Deku Tree dungeon.

subject: Fairy Ocarina
text: After clearing the Deku Tree, Saria gives Link the Fairy Ocarina when he attempts to leave Kokiri Forest.

evidence.quote:
Gotten: After clearing the Deku Tree, attempt to leave Kokiri Forest and Saria
 will give you this.

subject: Ocarina of Time
text: After collecting all Spiritual Stones, Link obtains the Ocarina of Time by jumping into the trench at Hyrule Castle to grab the instrument Zelda threw, which replaces the Fairy Ocarina.

evidence.quote:
After getting all the Spiritual Stones, try returning to Hyrule Castle
 to get a scene to play. Afterwards, jump into the trench and grab the Ocarina
 Zelda threw. Once you get this, it replaces your Fairy Ocarina.

subject: Bombchus
text: Bombchus can be found in treasure chests, purchased at certain stores, or won at the Bombchu Bowling Gallery in Castle Town.

evidence.quote:
Gotten: Many places. Some are in treasure chests, other times you can buy them
 at certain stores, you can even win them at the Bombchu Bowling Gallery in
 Castle Town.

subject: Hookshot
text: Winning Dampé's race inside his grave in Kakariko Graveyard as Adult Link rewards the Hookshot.

evidence.quote:
Gotten: From Dampe. Win his race (in his grave as Adult Link in Kakariko 
 Graveyard) and he will give you this.

subject: Longshot
text: The Longshot is obtained in the Water Temple and replaces the normal Hookshot.

evidence.quote: Once you get this, it replaces the normal Hookshot...Gotten: In the Water Temple.

subject: Boomerang
text: The Boomerang is obtained in the Jabu-Jabu's Belly dungeon for Young Link.

evidence.quote: Gotten: In the Jabu-Jabu's Belly dungeon for Young Link.

subject: Lens of Truth
text: The Lens of Truth is obtained in the Bottom of the Well sub-dungeon for Young Link.

evidence.quote: Gotten: In the Bottom of the Well sub-dungeon for Young Link.

subject: Magic Beans
text: A man in Zora's River sells up to 10 Magic Beans at ever-rising prices.

evidence.quote:
Gotten: The guy who eats beans in Zora's River. He sells them at ever-rising
 prices. He holds up to 10 Magic Beans.

subject: Fairy Bow
text: The Fairy Bow is obtained in the Forest Temple and currently holds 30 arrows.

evidence.quote:
Fairy Bow...This is a projectile attack for Adult Link. It currently holds 30
 arrows...Gotten: In the Forest Temple.
